## Overview

On gfx950 with AITER, `--attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype":"mxfp4"}'` now also serves DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5.x, MTP drafts included: their indexer writes the paged MXFP4 K cache that #58671 added for DeepSeek-V4.1, and the existing ROCm MXFP4 indexer scores it in place. FP8 stays the default. The code applies to main on its own; the gains below are measured on top of #61943, which should land first. Related: #48558, #60834.

## Claims

- GLM-5.2-MXFP4, MI355X, TP4, on top of #61943: KV cache +3.0% tokens; 128K/1K TPOT -5.4% / -5.9% at c8 / c16, MTP3 c8 -6.8%, TTFT -7% to -8%; c1 and 8K/1K within noise; gsm8k and passkey unchanged.
- Against main: 128K/1K TPOT -7.6% / -9.6% / -9.5% at c1 / c8 / c16, MTP3 c8 -6.7%.
- DeepSeek-V3.2, TP4, on top of #61943: KV cache +10.2% tokens; 128K/1K c8 TPOT -12.5%; c1 and 4K/1K c16 within noise; gsm8k unchanged.
- The FP8 default, gfx942, AITER off and non-ROCm platforms are unchanged.

## Validation

- `test_fused_deepseek_v32_norm_rope.py`, `test_rocm_paged_mxfp4_indexer_plan.py`, `test_rocm_paged_mxfp4_indexer.py`, MI355X: 274 passed, 8 skipped. pre-commit clean.
- Serving, mean TPOT (ms), 4 runs per arm for GLM-5.2 128K c8 / c16, MTP3 and DeepSeek-V3.2 4K, 2 elsewhere, no failed requests:

| workload | #61943 | + this PR | change |
|---|---|---|---|
| GLM-5.2 128K/1K c1 / c8 / c16 | 13.90 / 43.17 / 76.66 | 13.69 / 40.82 / 72.15 | -1.5% / -5.4% / -5.9% |
| GLM-5.2 MTP3 128K/1K c8 | 33.95 | 31.63 | -6.8% |
| GLM-5.2 8K/1K c8 | 17.50 | 17.49 | within noise |
| DeepSeek-V3.2 128K/1K c1 / c8 | 13.74 / 66.02 | 13.67 / 57.78 | -0.5% / -12.5% |
| DeepSeek-V3.2 4K/1K c16 | 22.85 | 23.34 | +2.1%, one outlier run (below) |

- gsm8k strict: GLM-5.2 20-shot 0.9272 to 0.9325 (stderr 0.007), DeepSeek-V3.2 5-shot 0.9515 to 0.9575 (stderr 0.006). GLM-5.2 passkey 26/26 in both arms.

<details>
<summary>Per-run numbers, kernel data and reproduction</summary>

Image `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly` (AITER 0.1.25) running #61943 at 0473a1e and this branch cherry-picked onto it (no conflicts), from source, MI355X. GLM-5.2 runs use `--max-model-len 133120`; DeepSeek-V3.2 runs keep the default (163840).

The new kernel tests compare the written K pages byte for byte with a reference built from the layout description, score them with AITER's kernel, and check the MXFP4 query against torch. A transposed scale plane, scales in natural order or a wrong `n_per_tile` each make them fail. MTP3 acceptance length: 3.49 without, 3.45 with this PR.

Mean TPOT per run (ms). Sessions, one server each: #61943 | PR, PR | #61943, then for the 4-run points PR, PR | #61943, #61943. MTP3 and DeepSeek-V3.2 follow the same order.

| workload | #61943 | + this PR |
|---|---|---|
| GLM-5.2 8K/1K c8 | 17.45, 17.55 | 17.58, 17.40 |
| GLM-5.2 128K/1K c1 | 14.14, 13.66 | 13.81, 13.58 |
| GLM-5.2 128K/1K c8 | 43.41, 43.07, 43.05, 43.15 | 41.02, 40.68, 40.84, 40.73 |
| GLM-5.2 128K/1K c16 | 77.92, 76.08, 76.51, 76.12 | 74.48, 71.18, 71.55, 71.38 |
| GLM-5.2 MTP3 128K/1K c8 | 34.80, 33.38, 33.91, 33.69 | 32.33, 31.51, 31.26, 31.42 |
| DeepSeek-V3.2 4K/1K c16 | 22.68, 23.09, 22.86, 22.77 | 23.09, 24.46, 22.89, 22.92 |
| DeepSeek-V3.2 128K/1K c1 | 13.79, 13.70 | 13.69, 13.65 |
| DeepSeek-V3.2 128K/1K c8 | 66.49, 65.55 | 57.96, 57.60 |

- Median ITL (ms): GLM-5.2 128K c1 13.80 to 13.69, c8 17.12 to 16.74, c16 20.24 to 19.54, MTP3 c8 25.44 to 24.34; DeepSeek-V3.2 128K c8 20.78 to 19.38, 4K c16 21.26 to 21.37.
- Mean TTFT (s): GLM-5.2 128K c1 8.20 to 7.84, c8 36.9 to 33.9, c16 68.2 to 63.3, MTP3 c8 38.1 to 35.0; DeepSeek-V3.2 128K c8 62.4 to 53.6. Output throughput at 128K: GLM-5.2 c8 +7.0%, c16 +7.0%, MTP3 c8 +7.8%; DeepSeek-V3.2 c8 +15.2%.
- The DeepSeek-V3.2 4K/1K c16 run at 24.46 ms had tail stalls (p99 ITL 33.7 ms, 22-25 ms in the other seven runs); without it the PR mean is 22.97 (+0.5%).
- KV cache tokens: GLM-5.2 3,206,592 to 3,303,424 (MTP3 2,969,088 to 3,058,112); DeepSeek-V3.2 2,074,240 to 2,286,656. DeepSeek-V3.2 has an indexer on every layer, GLM-5.2 on 21 of them.
- Against main, earlier sessions with the same flags (main | PR, PR | main; MTP3 PR, PR | main, main): 128K/1K TPOT 14.69 / 44.95 / 79.01 to 13.58 / 40.63 / 71.52, MTP3 c8 34.65 to 32.31, TTFT -9%, 8K/1K c1 / c8 / c16 within 1%, gsm8k 20-shot strict 0.9181 to 0.9212. Its PR arm matches the PR arm above within 1.5%.

Decode indexer per step (us), GLM-5.2 indexer (32 heads, k=2048, 64-token pages), scoring and top-k for 21 layers captured in one graph, LLC flushed before each replay, median of 20. FP8 scorer with AITER top-k (#61943) to this PR's MXFP4 path, its per-step schedule included:

| context | 1 row | 8 rows | 16 rows |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4K | 209 to 210 | 230 to 263 | 257 to 252 |
| 32K | 406 to 413 | 580 to 487 | 745 to 570 |
| 128K | 762 to 704 | 1419 to 972 | 2027 to 1274 |

At 128K and 8 rows the scorer alone drops from 816 to 334 us; top-k is the same AITER kernel on both sides. With 4 rows per sequence (MTP3) the MXFP4 path takes native next_n rows: 128K, 8 sequences 2573 to 1209 us.

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MLA=1 \
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_RMSNORM=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=0 \
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP8BMM=0 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4BMM=0 \
vllm serve amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4 --tensor-parallel-size 4 --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --block-size 64 --no-enable-prefix-caching --max-model-len 133120 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype":"mxfp4"}'
# MTP3: --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}'
# DeepSeek-V3.2: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.2, same env and flags without --max-model-len.

# 128K/1K: num-prompts max(C, 3), --seed 43. 8K/1K c8: --random-input-len 8192,
# 24 prompts, --seed 42. DeepSeek-V3.2 4K/1K c16: --random-input-len 4096, 48 prompts, --seed 42.
vllm bench serve --backend vllm --model amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4 --dataset-name random \
  --random-input-len 131072 --random-output-len 1024 --ignore-eos --temperature 0 \
  --num-prompts $N --max-concurrency $C --seed 43

# --num_fewshot 5 for DeepSeek-V3.2
lm_eval --model local-completions --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 20 --batch_size 1 \
  --model_args model=amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64,tokenized_requests=False

VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 pytest -v tests/kernels/test_fused_deepseek_v32_norm_rope.py \
  tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_paged_mxfp4_indexer_plan.py \
  tests/kernels/attention/test_rocm_paged_mxfp4_indexer.py
```

Passkey: a 5-digit key at a random depth of 32K / 64K / 120K tokens of filler, chat completion with thinking off, 26 prompts.

</details>

## Details

- Write path: AITER's `k_norm_rope_mxfp4_cache` (DeepSeek-V4.1) applies RMSNorm and RoPE on the last dims; the V3.2 and GLM indexer key takes LayerNorm with bias and interleaved RoPE on the first 64 dims. So `fused_norm_rope` and `fused_q` quantize the key and query themselves, with AITER's scale rule and the page order from AITER's `cache_format()`.
- Gain: the scorer reads 68 instead of 132 bytes per key, and prefill scores the paged cache in place instead of gathering K. Both grow with context and batch. Short contexts pay the per-step decode schedule (about 25 us at 8-16 rows); 8K and 4K serving shows no change beyond noise.
- Limits: 64- or 128-token pages (other `--block-size` values fail at startup), no DCP or PCP (rejected at startup), gfx950 with AITER only. The new kernel tests need gfx950 and run in the optional MI355 kernels step.

<details>
<summary>Design notes, related PRs and duplicate search</summary>

- MTP draft layers that reuse the target's top-k skip the query quantization. The model check uses `architectures`, because MTP drafts carry the rewritten `deepseek_mtp` model_type.
- #60834 (open) edits the same check in `dsa_indexer_uses_fp4` to add DeepSeek-V4 by model_type and adds its backend class next to this one; whichever lands second takes the union.
- #48558 (open, needs rebase) adds an MXFP4 indexer cache for GLM-5.2 on CUDA sm_100 through the legacy `deepseek_v2` indexer and the `use_fp4_indexer_cache` flag that #52550 replaced. It does not touch ROCm and reports +3.5% KV with neutral latency on B200.
- #57517 and #56834 add ROCm MXFP4 indexing for DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 only. #60042, #60294 and #60756 change the ROCm FP8 scorer kernels and #59421 adds native FP8 decode above next_n=2; each would narrow the gain if it lands. #53953 edits `deepseek_v32/amd/rocm.py`.
- Duplicate search, `gh pr list --state all --search`: "mxfp4 indexer ROCm", "fp4 indexer cache", "indexer_kv_dtype", "MXFP4 indexer GLM", "mxfp4 indexer DeepSeek-V3.2", "paged mxfp4 indexer", "RocmSparseAttnIndexer", "fused_norm_rope mxfp4", "GLM-5 ROCm indexer", "indexer cache fp4 AMD".

</details>

Not a duplicate: #48558 covers CUDA through a removed flag, and the ROCm MXFP4 indexer PRs (#57517, #56834, #60834) cover DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 only.

+def mxfp4_quant(x: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """[..., D] fp32 -> (e2m1 codes [..., D], e8m0 [..., D // 32]) with the
+    2^ceil(log2(amax / 6)) block scale, so nothing saturates."""
+    blocks = x.float().unflatten(-1, (-1, 32))
+    ratio = blocks.abs().amax(-1).clamp_min(6.0 * 2**-126) / 6.0
+    e8m0 = (ratio.view(torch.int32) + 0x7FFFFF) >> 23
+    inv_scale = ((254 - e8m0) << 23).view(torch.float32)
+    codes = quantize_to_e2m1(blocks * inv_scale.unsqueeze(-1)).flatten(-2)
+    return codes, e8m0.to(torch.uint8)

+def e2m1_pairs(codes: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Pack e2m1 codes two per byte, the even element in the low nibble."""

+    vals = torch.stack([table[(packed & 0xF).long()], table[(packed >> 4).long()]], -1)
